items.title: Fixed: November Windows 11 update failing with error 0x800f0993, 0x800f0989 or 0x80070306
items.summary: Some PCs that had the optional October preview update (KB5127936) could not install the November 2026 security update (KB5132061). Microsoft says it has now repaired affected PCs automatically through Windows Update, and the update then installs on its own.
items.whatToDo: Make sure the computer is connected to the internet, then open Windows Update and choose Check for updates. If the update still fails, use the Get Help app in Windows to contact Microsoft Support. Do not reset or reinstall Windows over this.

items.title: Windows 11 26H2: USB headsets and speakers with no sound
items.summary: After installing Windows 11 version 26H2, some USB audio devices did not start. Device Manager showed Code 10, and there was no sound. Microsoft fixed this in the November 2026 update (KB5132061).
items.whatToDo: Install the latest update from Windows Update, then restart the computer.

items.title: Windows 11 version 24H2 Home and Pro no longer get security updates
items.summary: Support for Windows 11 version 24H2 Home and Pro ended on October 13, 2026. The October 2026 update was the last one for these editions.
items.whatToDo: Update to Windows 11 version 26H2. Open Windows Update, choose Check for updates, then Download and install.

items.title: Windows 11 version 26H2 is now rolling out automatically
items.summary: Windows 11 version 26H2 is available for all eligible PCs. Since November 18, 2026, Microsoft is gradually installing it on home PCs running 24H2 or 25H2. It is a small update that installs quickly.
items.whatToDo: Nothing urgent. To get it now, open Windows Update, choose Check for updates, then Download and install.

items.title: Windows 10: free security updates now run until October 12, 2027
items.summary: Windows 10 support ended in October 2025. Microsoft extended its free Extended Security Updates program for home PCs by one more year, to October 12, 2027.
items.whatToDo: Make sure this PC is enrolled. Open Windows Update and look for the Extended Security Updates enrollment message. You may need to sign in with a Microsoft account. Plan a move to Windows 11 before October 2027.

items.title: AMD Radeon driver bug that kept writing to your drive is fixed
items.summary: AMD Software 26.11.1 (November 12) fixed heavy background writes to the system drive on Radeon RX 7000 and newer, including writes while moving or resizing windows. Version 26.11.2 (November 18) fixed the same problem for RX 5000 and RX 6000 on Windows 10, plus Smart Access Memory turning off after installing on Windows 10.
items.whatToDo: Update AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition to version 26.11.2 or newer.

items.title: NVIDIA RTX 50 series: video freezes or goes black after driver 621.01
items.summary: NVIDIA driver 621.14 (November 4, 2026) fixes video playback that could freeze or show a black screen on some GeForce RTX 50 series cards after driver 621.01.
items.whatToDo: Update the NVIDIA driver to 621.14 or newer, using the NVIDIA App or the NVIDIA website.

items.title: Older NVIDIA GTX 900 and GTX 10 series cards: install the security driver
items.summary: NVIDIA released security driver 582.78 on September 30, 2026 for older Maxwell, Pascal and Volta cards, which includes the GeForce GTX 900 and GTX 10 series.
items.whatToDo: Install NVIDIA driver 582.78 or newer from the NVIDIA website.
